intent: Reuse CAP-0002/3/4/5/7 to execute a bounded two-vintage SK hynix HBM3E supply trajectory in fresh PostgreSQL. Re-ground the March 19, 2024 contemporaneous source and the October 10, 2024 later retrospective together; preserve volume production as current Reality, preserve 'supply from late March' as immutable Judgment, project later evidence only as month-precision March 2024 customer-supply Reality, and evaluate the same supply event as a direct Outcome without inventing a day-level timing comparison or named qualification state.
rationale: Issue #154 proved the later SK hynix supply statement can be grounded 1/1/0/0. Existing owners already represent the remaining trajectory: CAP-0003 can project the March customer-supply Reality with month precision, CAP-0004 preserves the original approximate supply-timing Judgment and direct Outcome semantics, CAP-0005 provides no-lookahead replay, and CAP-0007 composes the phases. A narrow two-vintage run is preferable to replaying unrelated Samsung/Micron HBM states because it tests the exact same-event Outcome boundary without semantic noise.
